gen-flavors-gf-montagu-slab: Towering lowercase gives Flavors a stubby-pencil swagger. Montagu Slab, a text serif, softens that with sturdy downstrokes and slender turns, so whimsy and refinement share the line without a fight.
gen-flavors-gf-ovo: Ovo reads like a text serif with a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and thins only slightly lighter than its thicks. Flavors adds whimsy up top, loud and playful against that authority.
gen-fredoka-gf-hepta-slab: Fredoka draws a friendly pen line that never changes width, with an open e you can see into. Hepta Slab stretches out beneath it, bookish and dignified, giving each word a wide, unhurried stance.
gen-fredoka-gf-kiwi-maru: Soft, friendly and round, Fredoka holds one line width from start to finish. Kiwi Maru follows with generous letterspace and terminals that stop far from the stem, so a long passage would feel unhurried and traditional.
gen-fredoka-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Fredoka keeps a single pen width throughout, with an open e that stays friendly. Padyakke Expanded One, a text serif, spreads its glyphs wide like knots on a slack rope, so a heading made small would feel dwarfed by it.
gen-fredoka-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Approachable is the first word for Fredoka, drawn in one pen line with a gap in the e. And Stint Ultra Expanded, a text serif, floats each character apart, so a long passage would read slowly and traditionally.
gen-gf-autour-one-fs-bespoke-slab: Expressive from the first glance, Autour One cuts every stroke like ribbon of constant width. Bespoke Slab, a text serif, stands tall in each lowercase letter, so a long passage would feel grounded and refined.
gen-gf-autour-one-fs-erode: Bold and expressive, Autour One traces a constant-width outline. Erode, a serif with a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight and a broad aperture on the g and a, would carry a long passage with editorial dignity.
gen-gf-autour-one-fs-hoover: Expressive and bold, Autour One keeps its width through every turn with a clear channel into each round letter. But Hoover, a classic serif, holds back with compressed ascenders and a generous entry into the e, grounding the headline's energy.
gen-gf-autour-one-fs-trench-slab: Trench Slab reads dignified and refined, with hardly any gap between x-height and caps. Autour One adds a constant pen width and expressive roundness above it, which is the pair's real strength.
